name: Azərbaycan Altyazılar
_comment_description: This is what customers read inside Stremio's addon list. Keep it short and about what they get.
description: Film və seriallar üçün Azərbaycan dilində altyazılar. Quraşdırın, sonra film baxarkən altyazı menyusundan «Azərbaycan dili» seçin. Kolleksiya mütəmadi yenilənir. Pulsuz.
tagline: Filmlərə və seriallara Azərbaycan dilində altyazı
_comment_contact: type: telegram | whatsapp | instagram | email | none. value: @username, phone number in international form, or address.
_comment_catalog: false hides the film list from the public page and shows only the count.
_comment_lang: aze = ISO 639-2 for Azerbaijani. Stremio displays it as 'Azərbaycan dili'. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
_comment_hosting: Leave empty when the Cloudflare Worker serves the addon; it works the address out per request.
_comment_cleanup: Optional text cleanup applied to every subtitle.
_comment_lookup: If a file has no ttXXXXXXX id in its name, look the title up in Stremio's own Cinemeta catalog.
_comment_microdvd: Frames-per-second assumed when converting MicroDVD (.sub) files that don't declare their own.
